part3.text: What kind of decisions do you think are meaningful?
part3.answer: Meaningful decisions are those that have a long-lasting impact on one's life trajectory, such as choices regarding education, career, relationships, and values. These decisions shape our identity, happiness, and future opportunities, making them far more significant than everyday, trivial choices.

part3.text: What important decisions should be made by teenagers themselves?
part3.answer: Teenagers should be empowered to make decisions about their personal interests, hobbies, and social circles. These choices are fundamental to forming their identity and learning autonomy. However, major decisions with long-term consequences still benefit greatly from adult guidance and support.

part3.text: Why are some people unwilling to make quick decisions?
part3.answer: Many people hesitate due to a fear of making the wrong choice and facing potential regret or negative consequences. This indecisiveness can also stem from a desire for perfectionism or simply having too many options to analyze, which leads to feeling overwhelmed and paralyzed.

topics.answer: A pivotal decision I made with help was choosing which major to study at university. It was a difficult choice because I was torn between my personal interest in design and my family's preference for a more conventional field like business. I was deeply conflicted about following my passion versus ensuring future job security. The people who helped me most were my parents and my high school art teacher. My parents gave me a realistic perspective on career prospects, while my teacher encouraged my talent and convinced my parents of its value. We had several long, thoughtful discussions weighing the pros and cons. Ultimately, we compromised on a major in digital media, which blended creative design with technical skills. I felt incredibly supported and relieved. It showed me that a major decision doesn't have to be a solitary struggle and that collaborative thinking can lead to a wiser, more balanced outcome.

topics.title: Birthday

questions.text: What do you usually do on your birthday?
questions.answer: I usually have a small celebration with family or friends, like going out for dinner. Sometimes I just relax at home and enjoy some quiet time. Receiving birthday wishes from loved ones always makes the day special.

questions.text: What did you do on your birthday when you were younger?
questions.answer: As a child, I had fun parties with cake, games, and gifts. My parents often invited my friends over for celebrations. I also loved blowing out candles and making a wish.

questions.text: Do you think it is important for you to celebrate your birthday?
questions.answer: Yes, because it's a chance to appreciate life and connect with loved ones. However, some people may prefer a simple day without big celebrations. Both ways are meaningful.

questions.text: Which birthday do you think is the most important to celebrate?
questions.answer: The 18th birthday is very important, as it marks becoming an adult. In some cultures, the 60th birthday is also special, representing a long life. Personal significance matters most.

topics.title: Staying up late

questions.text: Do you often stay up late?
questions.answer: Not really, unless I have something urgent to finish. I try to hit the sack before midnight ‘cause I can’t function well without enough sleep.

questions.text: What do you do when you stay up late?
questions.answer: I usually scroll through my phone or binge-watch some shows. Sometimes I lose track of time without even noticing it.

questions.text: What does it feel like the next morning if you stay up late?
questions.answer: Oh, I feel totally drained and kind of grumpy. It’s hard to get through the day without yawning all the time.

questions.text: Did you often stay up late when you were a kid?
questions.answer: No, not really. My parents made sure I went to bed early. I think the only time I stayed up late was during holidays or family events.

topics.title: Names

questions.text: Does your name have any special meaning?
questions.answer: Yes, it does. My name means “bright future” in Chinese. My parents picked it because they hoped I’d grow up happy and successful.

questions.text: How would you choose names for your next generation?
questions.answer: I’d probably choose something meaningful and easy to pronounce. If I have a baby one day, I’ll ask my parents for ideas too.

questions.text: Are there any differences between how Chinese people name their children now and how they did in the past?
questions.answer: Yeah, for sure. In the past, names were more traditional, but now people like modern or foreign- sounding names to make kids stand out.

questions.text: Does anyone in your family have the same name as you?
questions.answer: Nope, I’m the only one with this name. My parents wanted something a bit unique, so nobody else in my family has it.

questions.text: Version B: No, not really. I think flowers are nice to look at, but they don’t last long and I’m not a big fan of taking care of them. questions.text: Do you know anyone who loves flowers?
questions.answer: Definitely—my grandmother is a huge flower lover, and she even grows her own roses and orchids. She talks to them as if they were her pets. I think her passion for gardening is quite inspiring.

questions.text: Are there a lot of flowers where you live?
questions.answer: Well, not really. I live in a concrete jungle, so natural flowers are pretty rare. But during spring, local parks would plant seasonal flowers, which makes the city feel more alive.

questions.text: Do people in your country often send flowers to others?
questions.answer: Not really in daily life, but flowers are often given on special occasions like weddings or hospital visits. While older generations may find this a bit unnecessary, many young people in big cities are starting to embrace the idea. questions.text: What is the latest plan you made?
questions.answer: Actually, I just planned a weekend getaway with my friends. We’re going hiking in the mountains, and I even made a checklist so I won’t forget anything. It’s something I’ve been looking forward to for a while.

questions.text: What are the benefits of making plans?
questions.answer: Well, I guess the biggest advantage is that it helps you stay focused and manage your time more efficiently. It also gives you a sense of control, especially when life feels hectic. Without one, things can easily spiral out of control, leaving you overwhelmed and unproductive.

topics.title: Spare time

questions.text: Do you often have free time?
questions.answer: Yes, I have some free time during the week, especially in the evenings. After work, I usually have one or two hours to relax. But sometimes, when I’m busy, I don’t get much time to rest.

questions.text: What do you usually do in your spare time?
questions.answer: In my spare time, I enjoy watching TV shows or listening to music. Sometimes I go for a short walk in the park. These activities help me feel more relaxed after a long day.

questions.text: Which day do you have more free time on, Saturday or Sunday?
questions.answer: I usually have more free time on Sunday. On Saturdays, I often do chores or meet friends. But Sundays are quieter, so I can stay at home and take a break.

questions.text: Would you like to have more free time in the future?
questions.answer: Yes, I would love to have more free time. I think it’s important to relax and enjoy life. If I had more time, I would learn a new skill or travel more.

topics.title: Spending time by yourself

questions.text: Do you usually spend time by yourself?
questions.answer: Yes, I often spend time by myself, especially on weekdays. I think it’s a good way to relax and think clearly. Sometimes I just need some peace and quiet.

questions.text: What did you do last time you were by yourself?
questions.answer: Last time I was alone, I read a book and listened to some soft music. It was a peaceful evening, and I really enjoyed it. I didn’t use my phone much because I wanted to rest my mind.

questions.text: How do you usually spend your time by yourself?
questions.answer: I usually watch videos, write in my diary, or just lie on the sofa and do nothing. Sometimes I take a nap if I feel tired. I think doing simple things helps me recharge.

questions.text: Do you like spending time by yourself?
questions.answer: Yes, I really like it. It gives me a break from talking and working all the time. I feel more calm and focused after spending time alone.

topics.title: Being busy

questions.text: Are you busier now than when you were a child?
questions.answer: Yes, I’m definitely much busier now than when I was a child. Back then, most of my time was spent playing or studying a little, but now I have to handle both work and personal responsibilities. It sometimes feels like there’s not enough time in the day to get everything done.

questions.text: When was the last time you were busy?
questions.answer: The last time I was really busy was last month when I had to finish an important work project. I was working late almost every night and had to skip some of my usual activities. Luckily, after that period, things became much calmer.

topics.title: Puzzles

questions.text: Did you do puzzles in your childhood?
questions.answer: Yes, I did puzzles quite often when I was a child. My parents thought they were a good way to improve my problem-solving skills. I especially liked picture puzzles because they were both fun and challenging.

questions.text: When do you do puzzles, during your trip or when you feel bored?
questions.answer: I usually do puzzles when I feel bored or want to relax. Sometimes, I also bring a small puzzle book with me when I travel. It helps me pass the time, especially on long flights or train rides.

questions.text: Do you like doing word puzzles or number puzzles? Which is more difficult for you?
questions.answer: I enjoy doing word puzzles more because they help me learn new vocabulary. Number puzzles are more difficult for me since I’m not very good at maths. Still, I try both types from time to time to keep my mind active.

questions.text: Do you think it is good for old people to do puzzles?
questions.answer: Yes, I believe doing puzzles is very good for older people. It can help keep their memory sharp and improve their concentration. Plus, it’s an enjoyable way for them to spend their free time.

topics.title: Public transportation

questions.text: What kind of public transportation do you usually take?
questions.answer: I usually take the bus to get around the city because it’s convenient and affordable. The buses run quite frequently, so I don’t have to wait too long. Sometimes, when I’m in a hurry or traveling late at night, I take the subway since it’s faster and more reliable.

questions.text: Do most people prefer public transportation in your country?
questions.answer: Not really—most people in my country prefer driving their own cars because it gives them more freedom and comfort. However, in big cities where traffic is a nightmare, public transport is often the go-to option.

questions.text: Did you take public transportation when you were a kid?
questions.answer: Yes, I often took the bus to school when I was a kid because it was the easiest way to get there. My parents were usually busy, so relying on public transport was the norm for me. Looking back, it helped me learn how to manage on my own from a young age.

questions.text: Will there be more people taking public transportation in the future?
questions.answer: I think more people will turn to public transportation in the future, especially as fuel prices keep going up and traffic gets worse. With cities investing in better and greener transport systems, taking the bus or train might become the smarter choice.

topics.title: Jewelry

questions.text: Do you often wear jewelry？
questions.answer: Not really. I usually keep things simple, so I don’t wear jewelry every day. But if I’m going to a special event or dressing up, I might put on a necklace or a ring. It just depends on the occasion.

questions.text: What types of jewelry do you like?
questions.answer: I like simple and elegant pieces, like small gold earrings or a silver bracelet. Nothing too flashy. I prefer things that go well with everyday outfits. Comfort matters a lot to me too.

questions.text: Do you usually buy jewelry?
questions.answer: Not often. I usually get jewelry as gifts on special occasions like birthdays or anniversaries. If I do buy something, it’s usually because I really love the design or it has some meaning. I’m not someone who shops for jewelry just for fun.

questions.text: Why do you think some people wear a piece of jewelry for a long time?
questions.answer: I think it’s often because the jewelry has sentimental value. It might be a gift from someone special or something that reminds them of an important memory. Wearing it makes them feel connected to that person or moment. It’s more than just an accessory for them.

topics.title: Geography

questions.text: Do you like geography?
questions.answer: Yeah, I think geography is pretty interesting. I enjoy learning about different places and how people live around the world. It makes me see things from a broader perspective. It’s not my favorite subject, but I do like it.

questions.text: Have you ever learned geography?
questions.answer: Yes, I studied it in school. We learned about continents, weather patterns, and how natural disasters happen. It was actually more fun than I expected. I still remember some of the maps we used in class.

questions.text: Do you want to be a geography teacher?
questions.answer: Not really, teaching isn’t something I see myself doing. I enjoy geography, but I think I’d rather explore new places than teach about them. Maybe something like travel blogging would suit me better. It just feels more exciting.

questions.text: Will you learn more about the geography of other countries?
questions.answer: Yeah, I’d love to! I think it’s cool to understand how landscapes and cultures change from place to place. It also helps when traveling or watching the news. Knowing more about the world is always a good thing.

questions.text: Do you think geography is useful?
questions.answer: Definitely. It helps us understand the world we live in, like where resources come from or why certain areas have different climates. It’s also useful for travel and even for global issues like climate change. So yeah, I’d say it’s really practical.

topics.title: Machine

questions.text: What is your favourite machine in your home?
questions.answer: I think my favorite machine is the air fryer. It’s super easy to use and saves me a lot of cooking time. I can make fries, chicken, and even desserts without much oil. It’s really convenient and healthier than using a deep fryer.

questions.text: Do you think washing machines and sweeping machines are important?
questions.answer: Yes, they’re really important, especially for busy people. Washing clothes by hand takes a lot of time and energy. And sweeping robots help keep the floor clean without much effort. These machines make housework so much easier.

questions.text: Do you read the instructions before using a machine?
questions.answer: Sometimes I do, especially if the machine looks complicated. If it’s something simple, I usually just try it myself first. But for things like coffee machines or kitchen tools, I prefer to check the manual. It helps me avoid breaking it.

questions.text: Do you think it is important to read the instructions?
questions.answer: Yes, it’s quite important. Instructions show you how to use the machine safely and properly. Without them, you might damage the machine or hurt yourself. So I think it’s always better to take a look before using anything new.

topics.title: Memory

questions.text: Are you good at memorising things?
questions.answer: I think I’m okay at it. I can remember faces and daily tasks pretty well, but I sometimes forget names or numbers. It depends on how interested I am in the thing I’m trying to remember.

questions.text: Have you ever forgotten something important?
questions.answer: Yes, once I forgot my friend’s birthday and felt really bad about it. I was busy with school and totally lost track of the date. Since then, I always set reminders on my phone for important events.

questions.text: What do you need to remember in your daily life?
questions.answer: Mostly things like school deadlines, meeting times, and what I need to buy. I also try to remember people’s birthdays and appointments. If I don’t write them down, I’ll probably forget.

questions.text: How do you remember important things?
questions.answer: I usually use my phone to set alarms or make notes. Sometimes I also write things down in a notebook if they’re really important. Visual reminders help too, like sticky notes on my desk.

topics.title: Text Messages

questions.text: Is sending messages popular in your country?
questions.answer: Absolutely, texting is extremely popular, with most people using messaging apps like WeChat or QQ. Even formal communications, such as work updates, often happen through instant messages. Older generations have also adapted well to digital messaging in recent years.

questions.text: Did you send more messages when you were younger?
questions.answer: Yes, as a teenager, I sent way more casual texts to friends, often just chatting about random things. Now, my messages tend to be more purposeful, like making plans or discussing important matters. Social media interactions have partly replaced constant texting.

questions.text: Do you reply to messages as soon as you receive them?
questions.answer: I try to reply promptly, especially if it's urgent or from family/work contacts. However, I don’t feel pressured to respond immediately to non-urgent chats. Sometimes I intentionally delay replies if I need time to think or am busy.

topics.title: Snacks

questions.text: When do you usually eat snacks now?
questions.answer: I usually eat snacks in the afternoon when I feel a bit hungry. Sometimes I also eat something small at night while watching TV. It helps me relax after a busy day.

questions.text: Do you think it is healthy for you to eat snacks?
questions.answer: It depends on the kind of snack. If I eat fruits or nuts, I think it's healthy. But if I eat too many chips or sweets, it’s not good for my body.

questions.text: Did you often eat snacks when you were young?
questions.answer: Yes, I ate snacks almost every day after school. My parents gave me cookies or small cakes. I really enjoyed eating them with my brother.

questions.text: What snacks do you like to eat?
questions.answer: I like to eat chocolate and popcorn. Sometimes I eat dried fruit or yogurt when I want something healthier. I also enjoy ice cream in summer.

topics.title: Patience

questions.text: Are you a patient person?
questions.answer: I think I am a little patient. I can wait for things if I know they are important. But sometimes I get annoyed if things take too long.

questions.text: What makes you feel impatient?
questions.answer: I feel impatient when the bus is late or when I have to wait in a long line. I also don’t like slow internet—it really makes me upset.

questions.text: How do you feel when you have to do something for a long time?
questions.answer: I feel bored if the task is not interesting. Sometimes I also get tired. But if I enjoy the activity, I don’t notice the time.

questions.text: Are you more patient now than when you were a child?
questions.answer: Yes, I think I have become more patient. When I was a child, I wanted everything quickly. Now I try to stay calm and wait.

topics.title: Writing

questions.text: Do you write a lot?
questions.answer: Not really. I only write when it's absolutely necessary, like jotting down important notes or penning an occasional email. My job doesn't require me to put pen to paper frequently.

questions.text: What do you like to write? Why?
questions.answer: I really enjoy writing travel diaries. It’s a great way to capture the highlights of my trips, like amazing landscapes and unforgettable experiences. Putting my thoughts and feelings on paper helps me relive those precious moments and share them vividly with others.

questions.text: Do you think the things you write would change?
questions.answer: I definitely think they will. As I gain more life experiences and my perspectives evolve, my writing style will likely undergo a transformation. Also, with changing trends and new technologies emerging, the topics I choose to write about might shift gears too.

questions.text: Do you prefer typing or handwriting when you are writing?
questions.answer: I usually prefer typing. It's much quicker and more convenient, especially when I need to make edits or search for information on the fly. However, for taking notes during a lecture or jotting down ideas spontaneously, I find handwriting helps me focus better and leaves a stronger impression.

topics.title: Weather

questions.text: What's the weather like where you live?
questions.answer: Where I live, the weather is quite changeable. We often experience four distinct seasons. In summer, it can get scorching hot, while winter brings biting cold and sometimes even snow. Spring and autumn are more moderate, with pleasant breezes and comfortable temperatures.

questions.text: Do you prefer cold or hot weather?
questions.answer: I definitely prefer cold weather. When it’s chilly outside, I can snuggle up in warm blankets and enjoy a hot cup of cocoa, which is incredibly cozy. Also, I find it easier to layer up with stylish clothes in cold weather rather than sweating buckets in the sweltering heat.

questions.text: Do you prefer dry or wet weather?
questions.answer: I much prefer dry weather. Wet weather often means getting soaked when I'm out and about, which can be a real hassle. In dry weather, I can freely enjoy outdoor activities without having to worry about muddy shoes or damp clothes, and it just puts me in a brighter mood.

questions.text: Are you in the habit of checking the weather forecast? When and how often?
questions.answer: Yes, I’m definitely in the habit of checking the weather forecast. I do it every morning without fail, usually by using a weather app on my phone. This helps me plan my day properly, like deciding what to wear and whether I should bring an umbrella or not. It’s a quick and easy way to stay one step ahead of the weather.

topics.title: Saying ‘thank you’

questions.text: Have you ever sent a thank you card to others?
questions.answer: Yes, I have. I once sent a thank - you card to my teacher after she helped me a great deal with my studies. It was a small gesture, but I hoped it would convey my heartfelt gratitude. I picked a card with a beautiful design and wrote a sincere message inside.

questions.text: Do people in your country often say ‘thank you’?
questions.answer: In my country, saying “thank you” is deeply ingrained in our daily interactions. Whether it’s a simple favor like holding the door or a more significant act of kindness, people are quick to express their appreciation. It’s a common courtesy that helps keep social relationships harmonious.

questions.text: On what occasions do you say ‘thank you’?
questions.answer: I say “thank you” on numerous occasions. When someone offers me a helping hand, like lending me a book or giving me directions, I immediately express my gratitude. Also, after receiving a gift or being treated to a meal, saying “thank you” is a must to show my appreciation for their thoughtfulness.

questions.text: Why do people need to say ‘thank you’?
questions.answer: People need to say “thank you” because it’s a powerful way to strengthen relationships. Expressing gratitude makes others feel valued and recognized for their efforts. It also spreads positive vibes and creates a more harmonious and friendly social environment.

topics.title: Housework

questions.text: Do you do some cooking to help your family cook at home?
questions.answer: Yes, I often help out in the kitchen, especially during weekends or holidays. I usually prepare simple dishes like stir-fried vegetables or dumplings, and my parents really appreciate the effort. Although I’m not a master chef, I enjoy the process and feel more connected to my family when we cook together.

questions.text: Did you do some house cleaning when you were young?
questions.answer: Definitely. When I was in primary school, my parents asked me to do light chores like sweeping the floor or organizing my books. At the time, I didn’t enjoy it much, but looking back, it really taught me discipline and responsibility.

questions.text: Do you want to learn how to cook well?
questions.answer: Version A: Yes, I do. I think cooking is a practical life skill, and if I live alone one day, I’ll definitely need to cook for myself. Besides, being able to make a good meal for your loved ones is such a rewarding thing.

questions.text: Version B: To be honest, not really. I find cooking a bit stressful, especially when there’s a mess to clean up afterward, so I usually prefer ordering takeout. Unless I have to live by myself one day, I don’t think I’ll actively try to improve my cooking skills. find something stressful 觉得某事让人有压力 order takeout 点外卖 live by myself 独自生活 What housework do you like or dislike doing?
questions.answer: Well, I actually enjoy doing laundry because it’s kind of therapeutic and gives me a break from screens. But I really dislike washing the dishes, especially when there’s a greasy mess. If I had to choose, I’d rather fold clothes than scrub plates.

topics.title: Singing

questions.text: Do you like singing? Why?
questions.answer: Version A: Yes, I do! Singing helps me unwind, especially when I’m stressed out from schoolwork. Even though I’m not a great singer, I sing along to my favorite songs when I’m alone at home or in the shower.

questions.text: Version B: Not really, to be honest. I’ve never felt comfortable singing in front of people, and even when I’m alone, I rarely sing because I’m quite self-conscious about my voice. Unless it’s at karaoke with close friends, I usually avoid singing altogether. self-conscious about one’s voice 对自己的嗓音不自信 unless it’s at karaoke 除非是在卡拉 OK avoid something altogether 完全避免某事 Have you ever learnt how to sing?
questions.answer: Not formally, but I used to be in the school choir back in middle school. Although we didn’t get professional training, I learned how to sing in harmony and follow rhythm. It was a fun experience that gave me more confidence.

questions.text: Who do you want to sing for?
questions.answer: That’s a lovely question. I’d want to sing for my mom, because no matter how off-key I was, she never laughed or judged me—instead, she always supported me wholeheartedly. If I ever got the chance to perform again, she’d be the first person I’d want in the front row.

questions.text: Do you think singing can bring happiness to people?
questions.answer: Yes, for sure. Singing is a great emotional outlet—it lifts your mood and helps you feel more positive. Whether you’re performing or just singing alone, it can really brighten your day.

topics.title: Outer Space and Stars

questions.text: Have you ever learnt about outer space and stars?
questions.answer: Yes, I studied basic astronomy in school, covering topics like the solar system and star constellations. I also enjoy watching documentaries about black holes and galaxy formations to satisfy my curiosity.

questions.text: Do you like science fiction movies?
questions.answer: I love sci-fi movies, especially those set in space like Interstellar and Gravity. They blend imaginative storytelling with scientific concepts, making space exploration feel thrilling and thought-provoking.

questions.text: Do you want to know more about outer space?
questions.answer: Definitely! I’m particularly curious about exoplanets and whether life exists beyond Earth. With new telescopes like James Webb, discoveries about the universe are accelerating, and I’d love to keep up with these advancements.

questions.text: Do you want to go into outer space in the future?
questions.answer: While the idea is exciting, I’d be nervous about the risks of space travel. However, if technology makes it safer and more affordable, I’d consider a short trip to experience zero gravity and see Earth from space!

topics.title: Lists

questions.text: Do you make a list when you shop?
questions.answer: Yes, I always make a shopping list to avoid impulse buys and ensure I don’t forget essentials. It helps me stay organized and saves time in crowded stores.

questions.text: Do you make a list for your work?
questions.answer: Absolutely—I rely on to-do lists to prioritize daily tasks and deadlines. Crossing off completed items gives me a sense of progress and reduces stress.

questions.text: Why don’t some people like making lists?
questions.answer: Some find lists restrictive or time-consuming to maintain, preferring flexibility. Others may feel overwhelmed seeing all tasks written down at once.

questions.text: Do you prefer to make a list on paper or your phone?
questions.answer: I prefer digital lists (like Notes or reminders) for convenience and syncing across devices, but handwritten lists feel more satisfying for quick daily tasks.

topics.title: Internet

questions.text: When did you start using the Internet?
questions.answer: I started using the internet when I was around ten years old, mainly to watch cartoons and play games.

questions.text: How often do you go online?
questions.answer: I go online several times a day, usually to check messages, watch videos, or look up information.

questions.text: How does the internet influence people?
questions.answer: The internet changes the way people work, learn, and communicate—it makes things faster and more convenient.

questions.text: Do you think you spend too much time online?
questions.answer: Yes, sometimes I feel I spend too much time online, especially when I scroll through social media without noticing the time.

questions.text: What would you do without the Internet?
questions.answer: Without the internet, I think I would read more books, go outside more often, and maybe spend more time with my family.

topics.title: Praising

questions.text: Have you had any achievements recently?
questions.answer: Yes, I recently finished an online course I had been working on for weeks, and I felt really proud of myself.

questions.text: How do you feel when you are praised?
questions.answer: When someone praises me, I feel happy and more confident, especially if I’ve worked hard on something.

questions.text: When was the last time you praised someone?
questions.answer: I praised my friend last week because she gave a great presentation in class, and I thought she really deserved it.

questions.text: Do you think parents should often praise their children?
questions.answer: Yes, I think regular praise helps children feel encouraged and motivates them to do better in the future.

topics.title: Small Business

questions.text: Have you had any achievements recently?
questions.answer: Recently, I nailed a challenging project at work, which demanded meticulous planning and seamless teamwork. The sense of accomplishment from seeing it through to success has truly made my efforts pay off.

questions.text: Do you prefer buying things from big companies or small businesses?
questions.answer: I tend to lean toward small businesses, as they often exude a personal touch and offer one-of-a-kind products that big corporations can’t replicate, plus supporting local entrepreneurs gives me a warm fuzzy feeling inside.

questions.text: Have you ever worked in small businesses?
questions.answer: Yes, I once worked at a charming boutique café, where I honed my multitasking skills while juggling customer orders and ensuring a cozy ambiance, which taught me the value of dedication in tight-knit teams.

questions.text: Have you ever thought about starting your own business?
questions.answer: Yes, the idea has crossed my mind a few times—imagining launching a niche bookstore that doubles as a cozy reading nook, where I could curate unique titles and foster a community of book lovers.

topics.title: Chocolate

questions.text: Do you like eating chocolate?
questions.answer: Absolutely! I have a soft spot for high-quality dark chocolate with a rich, velvety texture, as it not only tantalizes my taste buds but also serves as a delightful pick-me-up during stressful days.

questions.text: How often do you eat chocolate?
questions.answer: I indulge in a piece of chocolate moderately, usually once or twice a week, as I believe in savoring its decadence without overdoing it—quality over quantity, as they say.

questions.text: Did you often eat chocolate when you were a kid?
questions.answer: Yes, I was quite the chocolate enthusiast as a kid—often sneaking a bar from the pantry whenever my parents weren’t looking, which made every snack time feel like a guilty pleasure.

questions.text: Why do you think chocolate is popular around the world?
questions.answer: Chocolate’s universal appeal stems from its ability to evoke feelings of comfort and indulgence, with its rich, versatile flavors catering to diverse palates and serving as a go- to treat for both everyday moments and special occasions.

part3.text: Are there many people growing their own vegetables now?
part3.answer: Yes, growing vegetables at home has become increasingly popular, especially among urban dwellers who want organic produce. Many people use balconies or small gardens to cultivate herbs, tomatoes, or leafy greens. This trend reflects a growing interest in sustainable living and food safety.

part3.text: Do you think it's good to let kids learn how to plant?
part3.answer: Absolutely, teaching kids to plant helps them understand nature and develop responsibility. It’s also a great way to encourage healthy eating habits if they grow vegetables. Plus, gardening can be a fun, educational activity that improves their patience and observation skills.

part3.text: What do you think of the job of a farmer?
part3.answer: Farming is a tough but essential profession that provides food for society. Despite the hard work, modern farmers use technology to improve efficiency and sustainability. Their contribution deserves more recognition and fair compensation for feeding the population.

topics.answer: The person I know who loves growing plants is my neighbor, Mrs. Chen, a retired teacher. She has turned her balcony and small garden into a lush green space filled with flowers, herbs, and even small fruit trees. She grows roses, mint, basil, and cherry tomatoes, which she often shares with neighbors. Mrs. Chen enjoys gardening because it helps her relax and stay connected with nature. She says watching plants grow gives her a sense of achievement and joy. Her passion is inspiring—she even teaches local children basic gardening skills on weekends.I admire Mrs. Chen because her dedication shows how small efforts can create beauty. Her garden is a peaceful retreat, and her kindness in sharing harvests makes our community warmer. She proves that growing plants isn’t just a hobby but a way to spread happiness.

topics.title: Describe a friend from your childhood.

cue.title: Describe a friend from your childhood.
points: and explain why you liked her/him.

part3.text: How important is childhood friendship to children?
part3.answer: I think it’s super important because childhood is when kids start learning how to get along with others. Childhood friends help them learn how to share, play fair, and care about others. These friendships also help kids feel supported at school. With good friends, school life feels more fun and less stressful, and they won’t feel so alone when they face problems.

part3.text: Do you think online communication through social media will replace face-to- face communication?
part3.answer: I don’t think so. Online chatting is fast and easy, but it often feels a bit cold. Face-to-face talks feel warmer and more real because we can see each other’s emotions and body language. We still need that human touch, especially when talking about serious or personal things. So I think both are useful, but face-to-face is still more meaningful.

part3.text: What's the difference between having younger friends and elder friends?
part3.answer: Younger friends bring energy and fun. They’re often more active, and they help you stay positive. On the other hand, elder friends usually give better advice and share more life experience. They can guide you when you’re confused or going through something hard. I think having both kinds of friends is really helpful in different parts of life.

topics.answer: One of my best childhood friends was a boy named Leo. We met in primary school and became close because we were in the same class. We used to hang out every day after school—either playing video games or riding our bikes around the neighborhood. Sometimes, we even built little tree houses in the park. I liked him a lot because he was super funny and always had my back. Even when I got into trouble, he never left me alone. We stayed close for many years, even though we went to different high schools later on. I think those memories really mean a lot to me, and I still smile when I think about them.

topics.title: Describe a person who inspired you to do something interesting.

cue.title: Describe a person who inspired you to do something interesting.

part3.text: What qualities make someoen a role model?
part3.answer: A role model should have positive qualities like honesty, responsibility, and kindness. They should also inspire others by setting a good example through their actions. These traits help others learn and grow as individuals.

part3.text: Why should children learn from role models?
part3.answer: Children should learn from role models because it helps them understand the difference between right and wrong. Good role models can teach important life values, such as respect, hard work, and kindness. This guidance can shape their future behavior and choices.

part3.text: Who can influence children more, teachers or parents?
part3.answer: Both teachers and parents play important roles, but parents usually have a stronger influence. They spend more time with their children and shape their early habits and attitudes. However, good teachers can also inspire children to develop new interests and skills.

part3.text: What kind of international news inspires people?
part3.answer: News stories about people overcoming challenges or helping others often inspire people. For example, reports about scientists making medical breakthroughs or communities supporting each other after natural disasters can be very motivating. These stories remind us of human strength and kindness.

topics.answer: One of my high school teachers, Mr. Chen, inspired me to join the school’s drama club. He was my English teacher and always encouraged students to try new activities and express themselves. During one of his classes, he mentioned that acting could improve our language skills and build our confidence. I had never thought about performing before, but his words motivated me to give it a try. I joined the drama club and ended up performing in a school play. It was challenging but also really exciting. Through this experience, I became more confident and made many new friends. Mr. Chen’s encouragement helped me discover a new passion and taught me the importance of stepping out of my comfort zone.

topics.title: Describe a friend of yours who is well dressed and is good at dressing up .

part3.text: Do you think young people know more about fashion and are better at dressing up than elderly people?
part3.answer: Yeah, I think young people are more into fashion trends because they’re always online and see what’s popular. They follow influencers and try new styles more often. Older people usually prefer comfort and stick to what they’re used to, which is totally fine too.

part3.text: Do you think people would use clothing to show their identity?
part3.answer: Definitely. People often dress in a way that reflects their personality or lifestyle. For example, someone who’s into street culture might wear sneakers and hoodies. Clothes can say a lot without words.

part3.text: Why do many people prefer to buy rather expensive clothes?
part3.answer: I think some people believe expensive clothes have better quality and last longer. Others might buy them to show status or feel more confident. It’s also about brand image—some people just like how certain brands make them feel.

topics.answer: One of my friends who’s really well dressed is my college classmate Lisa. We met during our freshman year, and she stood out right away because of her fashion sense. Her style is very chic and modern—she wears clean, simple pieces but always adds a touch of personality, like a bold necklace or stylish shoes. Lisa says dressing well makes her feel more confident and prepared for the day. She works part-time at a fashion boutique, so she’s always surrounded by new trends. I think she just genuinely enjoys putting outfits together and expressing herself through clothes. Even when she’s just wearing jeans and a t-shirt, she still manages to look put-together.

topics.title: Describe an intelligent person you know.

part3.text: Why are some children more intelligent than others?
part3.answer: Intelligence differences in children stem from a combination of genetic factors（遗传因素） and environmental influences. Some kids may have a natural aptitude（天赋） for learning, while others benefit from early stimulation, quality education, and supportive parenting. Additionally, nutrition, emotional security, and access to educational resources can significantly impact cognitive development（认知发展）.

part3.text: Who do you think plays a more important role in a child's development, teachers or parents?
part3.answer: Both parents and teachers are crucial, but parents have a more foundational impact（基础性影响） since they shape a child’s early values, emotional security（情感安全感）, and learning habits. Teachers, however, play a key role in formal education and social development, especially as children grow older. Ideally, strong collaboration（协作） between parents and teachers leads to the best outcomes.

part3.text: Do you think smart people tend to be selfish?
part3.answer: Not necessarily—intelligence and selfishness are not inherently linked（内在关联）. While some highly intelligent people may prioritize their goals（优先考虑自己的目标）, many use their abilities to help others, such as scientists developing life-saving technologies. Personality traits like empathy（同 理心） determine selfishness more than intelligence alone.

topics.answer: The intelligent person I'd like to describe is my university professor, Dr. Zhang, who teaches artificial intelligence. I first met him when I took his machine learning course last semester, and I was immediately impressed by his ability to explain complex concepts（复杂概念） in simple terms. Dr. Zhang holds a PhD from Stanford University and currently leads research on neural networks（神 经网络） at our university. What makes him truly remarkable is how he applies theoretical knowledge to solve real-world problems - he's already filed three patents for his innovations in medical AI diagnostics. I consider Dr. Zhang intelligent not just because of his academic achievements, but because of his multidimensional thinking（多维思考）. He can discuss philosophy, economics, and even art with equal depth, showing true interdisciplinary brilliance（跨学科才华）. His students often say he has the rare ability to make connections between seemingly unrelated fields, which I believe is the hallmark （特征） of genuine intelligence.

topics.title: Describe a person who shows his/her feelings very openly.

cue.title: Describe a person who shows his/her feelings very openly.

and explain how you feel about him/her

part3.text: Do you think it's good or bad for people to show feelings openly?
part3.answer: I think showing feelings openly can be both good and bad, depending on the situation. On the positive side, it helps people express themselves clearly and reduce stress. When someone is honest about their emotions, it can improve communication and build stronger relationships. However, if people express their feelings too often or in the wrong way, it might make others feel uncomfortable. So I believe it’s important to find a balance between honesty and self-control.

part3.text: Who tend to show their feelings more openly, adults or children?
part3.answer: In general, children tend to show their feelings more openly than adults. They are more direct and don’t usually hide how they feel, whether they are happy, angry, or sad. Adults, on the other hand, often learn to control their emotions because of social rules or professional situations. They may choose to stay calm even when they feel upset. So while children express emotions more naturally, adults often keep them inside.

part3.text: Regarding showing emotions, are there any differences between women and men?
part3.answer: Yes, there are often some noticeable differences between women and men when it comes to showing emotions. Women are generally more open and comfortable talking about their feelings. They tend to cry more easily or share emotional experiences with friends. Men, however, are sometimes taught to stay strong and hide their emotions, especially in public. Of course, this depends on the individual and also the culture they live in.

topics.answer: I’d like to talk about my friend Lily. She’s the kind of person who always shows her feelings, no matter where she is. I met her at university, and we’ve stayed close since then. When she’s happy, she laughs loudly and tells everyone the good news. But when she’s upset, she cries or talks about it right away. She doesn’t like hiding her emotions, and I think that’s because she’s very honest and open. She believes sharing feelings is better than keeping them inside. I’m quite different from her, as I usually stay quiet when I feel down. But I admire her courage to express herself. Being around Lily helps me feel safe to share more about myself. She makes people feel understood and supported.

topics.title: Describe a famous person you would like to meet.

cue.title: Describe a famous person you would like to meet.

and explain why you would like to meet him/her.

part3.text: What are the advantages and disadvantages of being a famous child?
part3.answer: Being a famous child can bring a lot of exciting opportunities, such as acting in films, attending big events, or earning money early. It can also help them build confidence and experience success at a young age. However, it also comes with serious pressure. Famous children are often watched closely by the public and media, which can affect their mental health. They may also lose a normal childhood, missing time to play, study, or make real friends.

part3.text: What can today's children do to become famous?
part3.answer: Today’s children can become famous by joining talent shows, posting videos on social media, or taking part in online competitions. Many young people have become well-known just by sharing their singing, dancing, or art online. Of course, it takes time and effort to build an audience. Some children also join special training schools to improve their skills. But it’s important that they enjoy what they’re doing, not just try to get attention.

part3.text: What can children do with their fame?
part3.answer: Children who become famous can use their fame to support good causes or raise awareness for important issues. Some choose to help charities or speak about things like education or health. Fame can also open doors for better education or career chances in the future. However, they need guidance to manage their fame wisely. Otherwise, it may lead to problems like stress or being taken advantage of.

part3.text: Do people become famous because of their talent?
part3.answer: In many cases, people become famous because they have a special talent, such as singing, acting, or playing a sport. Their skills stand out, and that attracts attention. However, sometimes people become famous just by going viral online, even if they don’t have strong abilities. So, talent is important, but luck and timing also play a big role. Long-term fame usually depends more on real talent and hard work.

topics.answer: I’d like to meet Emma Watson, the actress who played Hermione in the Harry Potter movies. I’ve known her since I was a child, as I watched all the Harry Potter films and really liked her performance. She’s not only a great actress, but also a strong supporter of women’s rights. If I had a chance, I’d love to meet her in a quiet café or at a book event. I would ask her about her work in acting and her efforts in helping people through her speeches and campaigns. I respect her because she’s smart, kind, and uses her fame to make a difference in the world. Meeting her would be a dream come true for me.

topics.title: Describe a person from a different cultural background with whom you enjoy spending time.

part3.text: Is it easy to meet people from different cultural backgrounds in your country?
part3.answer: In my country, it's becoming increasingly easy to meet people from different cultural backgrounds. Big cities are melting pots, teeming with international students, expats, and tourists. Additionally, various cultural exchange events and online platforms have also broken down barriers, making cross - cultural interactions a common occurrence.

part3.text: What do people from different cultural backgrounds usually talk with each other?
part3.answer: People from different cultural backgrounds usually talk about a wide range of topics. They often delve into their unique traditions and festivals, like sharing the stories behind special celebrations, which helps them gain a deeper understanding of each other's cultures. Another common subject is food, as they exchange information about local delicacies and cooking methods, which can be a real ice - breaker. Additionally, they might discuss travel experiences, highlighting the must - visit places in their home countries to inspire one another.

part3.text: Is it good to live in a multicultural society?
part3.answer: Living in a multicultural society is extremely beneficial. It acts as a rich melting pot where people can soak up diverse perspectives, fostering creativity and innovation. For instance, the exchange of different cuisines, art forms, and traditions enriches everyone's cultural experiences, making life more colorful and exciting. Moreover, it helps break down stereotypes and prejudices, promoting mutual understanding and harmonious coexistence among various groups.

topics.answer: I’d like to talk about my friend, Maria, who’s from Spain. We met at a language exchange event in our university. From the very first conversation, I was drawn to her vibrant personality and infectious enthusiasm. Spending time with Maria is always a treat. She loves sharing stories about Spanish traditions, like the lively flamenco festivals and the delicious tapas culture. I’ve learned so much from her, not just about her country but also about open - mindedness and embracing differences. Every moment with her is filled with laughter and new discoveries, and I truly cherish our friendship. drawn to：被…… 吸引 vibrant personality：充满活力的个性 infectious enthusiasm：富有感染力的热情 a treat：一件乐事 cherish our friendship：珍惜我们的友谊

topics.title: Describe a person who you think wears unusual clothes.

cue.title: Describe a person who you think wears unusual clothes.
points: and explain why you think his/her clothes are unusual.

part3.text: What are the differences between clothes worn by old people and those by young people?
part3.answer: Older people usually wear simple and comfortable clothes, like shirts, sweaters, and long pants. They often choose soft colors and loose styles. Young people prefer more fashionable items like jeans, hoodies, and sneakers. They care more about trends and use clothes to show their personality.

part3.text: What kinds of clothes do people wear in the workplace?
part3.answer: It depends on the job. In offices, people often wear formal clothes like suits, shirts, or dresses. In some creative jobs, casual clothes are also acceptable. Workers in factories or hospitals may wear uniforms. Some companies have dress codes to show professionalism.

part3.text: Do you think it’s a good idea to buy clothes online?
part3.answer: Yes, buying clothes online is convenient and offers more choices. You can compare prices and find many styles. But sometimes the size or material is not what you expected. So it’s important to check reviews and size charts before ordering.

part3.text: Do you think what people wear can influence their mood?
part3.answer: Yes, I think so. Wearing bright colors or clothes you like can make you feel happy and more confident. On the other hand, uncomfortable clothes or dull colors may affect your mood in a negative way. What we wear can reflect how we feel too.

topics.answer: Here is a guy in my neighborhood who always wears very unusual clothes. His name is Kevin, and I see him almost every day when I go to school. He is in his 30s, and he loves fashion, but in a very different way. Sometimes, he wears bright yellow pants with a purple jacket, or shoes with wings on them. One time, I saw him wearing a shirt with cartoon characters all over it. His clothes are always colorful and full of strange patterns. I don’t know where he buys his clothes, but they are definitely different from what most people wear. Some people laugh at his style, but I think it’s cool that he is confident and doesn’t care what others think. I believe his clothes are unusual because they are not what you see every day on the street.

topics.title: Describe an old person who you enjoy talking with.
topics.titleZh: 你喜欢与之交谈的长者

cue.title: Describe an old person who you enjoy talking with.
points: And explain how you feel about this person.

part3.text: What topics can young people talk about with old people?
part3.answer: Young people can talk with old people about family stories, past experiences, and life lessons. They can also ask for advice on relationships or work. Sometimes, they talk about health or even food and travel. These topics help build a connection and show respect to the elderly.

part3.text: Do old people and young people talk about the same things?
part3.answer: Not always. Young people usually talk about school, technology, or pop culture, while older people prefer to talk about history, family, or health. But they can still enjoy chatting if they find common interests, like food, hobbies, or travel.

part3.text: What can young people learn from the elderly?
part3.answer: Young people can learn a lot from older people, like how to deal with problems, be patient, or save money. The elderly often share useful tips and stories from their life. These lessons can help young people make better choices.

topics.answer: The old person I enjoy talking with is my grandfather. I have known him since I was born because he is part of my family. He is in his seventies, but he is full of energy and always smiling. He has a lot of life experience, so I always learn something new from him.We usually talk about his past and how life was when he was young. He tells me stories about his childhood and the challenges he faced. Sometimes, we also talk about current events, and he shares his opinions about them. He is very wise, and he often gives me advice about how to deal with problems in life.I feel very happy when I talk with him. He is patient and kind, and he always listens to me. I admire his positive attitude and the way he treats others. Talking with him makes me feel more confident and relaxed. He is definitely someone I respect and enjoy spending time with.

topics.title: Describe a person who persuaded you to do something.

cue.title: Describe a person who persuaded you to do something.
points: what this person persuaded you to do

part3.text: In general, is it easy to persuade people? Why or why not?
part3.answer: It’s not always easy to persuade people because everyone has different opinions. Some people are open- minded and easy to talk to, while others are more stubborn. If you use simple reasons and examples, it might be easier. But it also depends on your tone and body language.

part3.text: What kinds of people are more persuasive than others?
part3.answer: People who speak clearly and confidently are usually more persuasive. They know how to use facts and examples to support their ideas. Friendly people are also better at persuading others because they make you feel comfortable.

part3.text: Do children become more independent when they grow up?
part3.answer: Yes, most children become more independent as they grow up. They start to make their own choices, take care of daily tasks, and solve problems by themselves. Parents still guide them, but they learn how to manage things on their own.

topics.answer: Last year, my best friend Anna persuaded me to join a dance class. At first, I was shy and didn’t think I could do it. But Anna encouraged me by saying it would be fun and good for my health. She even went with me to the first class. She helped me learn the steps and cheered me up when I made mistakes. Her support made me feel more confident. After a few weeks, I started to enjoy the class and made new friends there. Without her push, I wouldn’t have tried something new. I think this experience taught me to be more open and brave.

topics.title: Describe a person you want to work or study with.

part3.text: What kinds of people do you like to work with?
part3.answer: I like working with people who are friendly and responsible. It’s easier to finish tasks when everyone helps each other. I also enjoy working with people who listen to different ideas and don’t always want to be the boss. Good teamwork makes everything smoother.

part3.text: Do you think team work is important?
part3.answer: Yes, teamwork is very important, especially in school or at work. When people work together, they can share ideas, finish work faster, and learn from each other. Even if problems come up, it’s easier to solve them as a group. Teamwork also helps build trust.

part3.text: What makes someone a good team member?
part3.answer: A good team member is someone who is kind, listens to others, and does their part. They should be honest and ready to help when someone needs support. Being on time and keeping promises also shows that you care about the team.

topics.answer: I’d like to study with my classmate Lily. We worked on a school project last semester. She is very organized and always finishes her work on time. I remember we did a science report together. We planned everything clearly, shared the work, and practiced our presentation many times. Lily also explained things to me when I didn’t understand. Studying with her was easy and enjoyable. She doesn’t get angry, and she always helps others. I think learning with her helps me do better and feel more relaxed.

topics.title: Describe a singer you like.

part3.text: What kinds of music are popular in your country?
part3.answer: In my country, pop music is the most popular, especially among young people. Many people also enjoy rap, rock, and soft love songs. Some older people prefer traditional music. These songs are often played on the radio, TV, and in shopping malls.

part3.text: Why do some people become famous singers while others don’t?
part3.answer: Some people become famous singers because they have great talent, work hard, and get good chances. They may also have strong support from music companies. Others might sing well, but without luck or support, it's hard to become famous.

part3.text: Do you think the lyrics or the melody is more important in a song?
part3.answer: I think both are important, but for me, the melody matters more. If the tune is catchy, people will remember the song even if the lyrics are simple. But good lyrics can make the song more meaningful and emotional.

topics.answer: I really like Taylor Swift. I started listening to her music when I was in high school. I usually listen to her songs at home or when I go for a walk. She sings pop and country music. Her voice is soft and her songs are full of feelings. My favorite song is “Love Story” because it’s very romantic. I like her because her songs tell stories and they make me feel better when I’m sad. She is also kind to her fans and works hard. I admire her a lot.

topics.title: Describe a noisy place you have been to.

cue.title: Describe a noisy place you have been to.
points: and explain why you feel it's a noisy place

part3.text: Which area is exposed to noise more, cities or the countryside?
part3.answer: Clearly, cities are much more exposed to noise because they’re filled with traffic, crowds, and constant construction. In contrast, the countryside tends to be quieter, where the main sounds come from nature like birds chirping or wind blowing.

part3.text: Should children not be allowed to make noise under any circumstances?
part3.answer: Personally, I think it’s too extreme to say kids should never make noise, since making sounds is part of how they express themselves. That said, in places like libraries or hospitals, it makes sense to ask them to be quiet out of respect for others. So instead of banning noise completely, parents should guide them to behave appropriately in different settings.

part3.text: How do people usually respond to noise in your country?
part3.answer: In general, if the noise is occasional, like a holiday celebration, most people just let it slide. However, when it becomes frequent or disruptive—like loud neighbors late at night—they might file a complaint or talk to them directly. These days, some people also use earplugs or noise-canceling headphones to block it out.

topics.answer: One of the noisiest places I’ve ever been to is a night market in downtown Guangzhou, which is super popular with both locals and tourists. I went there last summer during a short trip with two of my close friends, and we were really excited to explore it. We spent hours wandering through stalls, tasting snacks like grilled squid and stinky tofu. There were also street performers dancing right in the middle of the walkway, which added to the lively vibe. What made the place incredibly noisy was the mix of sounds—people shouting prices, music blasting from speakers, and kids running around laughing. I even had to raise my voice just to talk to my friends. At one point, it felt like a complete sensory overload. Even though I usually prefer quiet places, I enjoyed the buzz of the market. It was chaotic but full of raw energy, and that made it unforgettable. I’d love to go back one day, though maybe with earplugs next time.

topics.title: Describe a shop/store you often visit.

part3.text: Do people in your country go to shopping malls frequently?
part3.answer: Yes, many people in my country like going to shopping malls, especially young people. They go not only to buy things, but also to watch movies, eat food, or meet friends. On weekends, shopping malls are often very crowded. It’s a popular place to relax and spend time indoors. Some families also take their children there because malls are safe and have many things to do. For example, kids can play games while parents shop or have coffee.

part3.text: How have people’s shopping habits changed in recent decades?
part3.answer: In the past, people used to shop in markets and small stores. But now, online shopping has become very common. Many people use apps or websites to buy clothes, food, or other products. It’s faster and easier than going to real shops. Also, people now care more about delivery time and product reviews. They often compare prices before buying, which was not common before. Shopping today is more about convenience and saving time.

part3.text: Do you think shops and shopping malls will disappear in the future?
part3.answer: I don’t think they will disappear completely, but fewer people may visit them in the future. Online shopping is more popular now, but some people still enjoy going to shops to try things or meet friends. Also, shopping malls offer a social experience that online stores cannot. Some people like to touch the products or enjoy the shopping atmosphere. So I believe shops will still exist, but they may need to improve to attract customers.

topics.answer: There is a small supermarket near my home called Happy Mart. It is only five minutes away by walking, so I often go there after work or on the weekend. I visit it about three or four times a week. The shop is not very big, but it sells many daily things like fruits, snacks, drinks, and cleaning products. One reason I like this shop is because it is very clean and the staff are always friendly. They smile and say hello when I come in, which makes me feel welcome. The prices are also low compared to bigger shops, and they often give discounts on popular items. Another thing I enjoy is that the shop opens early in the morning and closes late at night. That means I can go there even when I finish work late. Overall, this store makes my life easier and more comfortable.

part3.text: Is there anything special about the villages in China?
part3.answer: Yes, there are many special aspects of Chinese villages. Firstly, traditional Chinese villages often boast unique architectural styles, with ancient courtyard houses and tiled roofs that carry a strong sense of history and cultural heritage. Secondly, the close - knit community in villages is remarkable, where neighbors help each other out without hesitation, embodying the spirit of unity and warmth. Additionally, villages in China are rich in agricultural traditions, with local farmers using time - honored methods to grow a variety of crops, which is a living testament to the country's long - standing farming culture.

part3.text: Why do people want to go to the countryside?
part3.answer: People often want to go to the countryside to get away from the rat race of urban life. The countryside offers a peaceful and laid - back atmosphere, allowing them to unwind and recharge their batteries. Moreover, the beautiful natural scenery, such as lush green fields and clear rivers, provides a refreshing break from the concrete jungles of the city.

part3.text: What do people usually do when going to a village?
part3.answer: When going to a village, people usually engage in a variety of activities. Many like to immerse themselves in nature, taking long hikes through the countryside to enjoy the fresh air and scenic views. Others may participate in hands - on rural experiences, such as helping with farm work or learning traditional handicrafts from local artisans, which gives them a taste of the rustic lifestyle.

topics.title: Describe an unusual but interesting building you would like to visit.

part3.text: Why do some people choose to build houses by themselves?
part3.answer: Some people choose to build houses by themselves for several good reasons. Firstly, it allows them to have full control over the design and layout, enabling them to create a home that is a perfect fit for their unique needs and preferences. Secondly, self - building can often be more cost - effective in the long run, as they can avoid some of the markups that come with purchasing a ready - made house. It's a hands - on way to bring their dream home to life.

part3.text: What factors do you consider when choosing a house or an apartment?
part3.answer: When choosing a house or an apartment, several crucial factors come into play. Location is of utmost importance; I'd look for a place close to essential amenities like schools, supermarkets, and public transportation, as it ensures convenience in daily life. Another key consideration is the layout and size of the property. It should have enough space to accommodate my needs comfortably and a floor plan that makes efficient use of the area. Finally, the overall condition and maintenance of the building are vital to avoid unexpected repair costs down the line.

part3.text: Do you think a city's buildings affect its vibe or atmosphere?
part3.answer: Absolutely, a city's buildings have a profound impact on its vibe or atmosphere. Skyscrapers and modern glass - fronted structures can give a city a dynamic, cosmopolitan feel, attracting businesses and creating a bustling, energetic environment. On the other hand, historic buildings with traditional architecture evoke a sense of nostalgia and charm, making the city feel more timeless and culturally rich.

topics.answer: I’d love to visit the Dancing House in Prague, Czech Republic. This remarkable building stands out along the Vltava River. It has a truly distinctive appearance, with curving, fluid lines that seem to mimic the graceful movements of dancers, hence its name. What makes the Dancing House unusual and interesting is its avant - garde design, which contrasts sharply with the surrounding historic architecture. It combines modern and post - modern elements in a way that’s both daring and captivating. I’m eager to visit it because I’m fascinated by architecture, and I believe seeing this building in person would offer a unique visual treat and inspire my creativity.

topics.title: Describe a popular place for sports (e.g. a stadium) that you’ve been to.

cue.title: Describe a popular place for sports (e.g. a stadium) that you’ve been to.

part3.text: Do young people like to do sports?
part3.answer: Many young people enjoy sports, especially team activities like basketball or soccer that combine exercise with socializing. However, some prefer individual fitness activities like gym workouts or yoga. The popularity of sports varies depending on personal interests and access to facilities.

part3.text: What are the benefits of sports for children?
part3.answer: Sports help children develop physical health, teamwork skills, and discipline. Regular exercise improves concentration and reduces stress, benefiting academic performance. Additionally, sports teach valuable life lessons like perseverance and sportsmanship.

part3.text: Is it necessary to build public sports spaces?
part3.answer: Yes, public sports spaces promote community health and social interaction. They provide accessible options for exercise, especially for those who can't afford gym memberships. Well-designed facilities encourage people of all ages to stay active.

topics.answer: The most impressive sports venue I've visited is the Beijing National Stadium, known as the "Bird's Nest." I went there last summer to watch an international athletics competition. This iconic stadium was packed with enthusiastic spectators, showing its enduring popularity years after the 2008 Olympics. The energy was electric as crowds cheered for athletes from different countries. What amazed me most was the stadium's innovative architecture - its steel lattice exterior looked even more magnificent in person. Sitting among thousands of cheering fans gave me goosebumps. The experience made me appreciate how sports can unite people across cultures.

topics.title: Describe a place you visited and enjoyed in the countryside

cue.title: Describe a place you visited and enjoyed in the countryside

part3.text: Why do people like to visit the countryside?
part3.answer: People like to visit the countryside because it’s peaceful and beautiful. There’s fresh air, green views, and fewer people. It’s a great place to relax and get away from the stress of city life. Some people also enjoy outdoor activities like hiking or fishing.

part3.text: What are the differences between city life and countryside life?
part3.answer: City life is fast and busy, with more jobs, schools, and shopping centers. But it’s also noisy and crowded. Countryside life is slower and quieter. People in the countryside often live in bigger houses and enjoy nature more. Life there feels more relaxed.

part3.text: Do you think it’s better for children to grow up in the countryside or in a city?
part3.answer: Both have advantages. In the city, children have better schools and more chances to join activities. But in the countryside, they can enjoy nature, play outside, and live a healthier life. I think it depends on the family’s needs and lifestyle.

topics.answer: Last summer, I visited my uncle’s farm in the countryside. It’s in a small village about two hours from the city. I went there with my family during the school holiday. The farm was full of green trees, animals, and fresh air. I helped feed chickens and picked vegetables. It was very different from city life. I liked the peace and quiet there. I also watched the stars at night, which I can’t do in the city. That trip made me feel relaxed and happy. I want to go there again.

part3.text: What makes a city attractive to tourists?
part3.answer: A city becomes attractive to tourists when it has famous landmarks, beautiful views, and interesting culture. Good food, clean streets, and friendly local people also make a big difference. If the city is easy to travel around and has good transport, tourists will enjoy it more. Events like festivals or concerts can also bring in more visitors.

part3.text: What impact does tourism have on popular cities?
part3.answer: Tourism brings money and creates jobs, which is good for the local economy. Shops, hotels, and restaurants all benefit. But it can also cause problems like noise, traffic, and pollution. In some places, too many tourists make daily life harder for local people. So, cities need to find a balance between welcoming visitors and protecting the environment.

part3.text: What sources of information do people usually use when planning to visit a new city?
part3.answer: People often check travel websites, watch YouTube videos, or read blogs when planning a trip. Many also look at reviews and pictures on apps like TripAdvisor or social media. Some people ask friends or family for suggestions. These sources help them know what to do, where to eat, and how to get around the city.

topics.answer: I went to Shanghai two years ago during the winter holiday. It’s a big city with many tall buildings, shopping centers, and famous places like the Bund. I went there with my cousin. We visited museums, tried different foods, and took many pictures. I want to visit again because there’s still so much to see, like Disneyland and the old streets. I also want to eat more local food. The city is modern and exciting, and I had a great time there.

topics.title: Describe a place in your country or part of your country that you would like to recommend to travellers.

part3.answer: Not all kids like to share, especially when they are very young. Some children want to keep their toys or snacks to themselves. But if they grow up in a kind and friendly environment, they can learn to enjoy sharing. It often depends on their personality and how they are taught.

part3.text: How can parents teach their children to share?
part3.answer: Parents can teach sharing by setting a good example. If kids see their parents share things with others, they will copy the behavior. Parents can also encourage children to take turns, praise them when they share, and explain why sharing is important in daily life.

part3.text: What do you think is the benefit of sharing for children?
part3.answer: Sharing helps children make friends and learn how to care about others. It also teaches them to be kind, patient, and understanding. These skills are important for working in groups later in life. Sharing also makes playtime more fun and helps build strong relationships.

topics.answer: Last semester, I had to share my textbook with a classmate. She forgot to bring hers, and we had a test that day. I moved my book between us so we could both see it. At first, it was a bit hard because we had to turn pages together, but later we worked well as a team. I shared it because I wanted to help her. I felt happy because she said thank you and did well on the test.

part3.text: What disagreements do parents and children usually have?
part3.answer: They often argue about school, bedtime, and phone use. Parents want kids to focus on studying, while kids want more freedom. Both sides think they’re right.

part3.text: Why do some people avoid arguing with others?
part3.answer: Some people avoid arguments because they don’t like drama or hurting others’ feelings. They prefer to stay calm and let things go.

part3.text: How do we show respect to others when we disagree with them?
part3.answer: We can listen carefully, wait for them to finish, and use polite words. Even if we don’t agree, we don’t have to be rude.

topics.answer: I had an argument with my best friend last year. We were planning a trip, but we disagreed on where to go. I wanted to visit the beach, but she preferred the mountains. Things got a bit heated because we both thought we were being fair. After a while, we stopped talking for a few days. Later, I sent her a message to say sorry, and we talked it out. In the end, we chose a place that had both sea and hills, so it worked out fine. I felt bad at first, but I was glad we made up in the end.

part3.text: What kinds of plants do young people often make?
part3.answer: Young people often make plans related to their education, career, and social activities. For example, they might plan to study abroad, find a good job, or attend concerts and trips with friends. These plans help them achieve personal goals and enjoy life.

part3.text: Why can't people always follow their plans?
part3.answer: People can’t always follow their plans because unexpected things often happen. For instance, personal problems, health issues, or changes at work can affect their original schedule. Flexibility is important when things don’t go as planned.

topics.answer: Last summer, I planned a beach barbecue party with about twenty of my friends and some family members. We decided to hold it at a local beach because it had great facilities and enough space for everyone. I started organizing everything a month before the event. I created a group chat to discuss the food, drinks, and games we could enjoy. Everyone was excited and helped by bringing different dishes or equipment. On the day of the barbecue, the weather was perfect, and we played beach volleyball, swam, and enjoyed delicious food together. I felt really happy because the plan worked out well, and it brought everyone closer. It also taught me the importance of teamwork and good communication when organizing group activities.
